messages:
Angela (PM): Quick sync — planning the staged rollout for the geo-prioritized model switch. Proposal: three phases (EU canary opt-in -> EU widen -> global staggered). Need concrete launch criteria, feature-flag matrix, canary success metrics, A/B windows, and fallback policy. Thinking feature flags like `ff.model_switch.eu_canary`, `ff.model_switch.eu_widen`, and `ff.model_switch.global` plus a fallback tiering to older model and regional routing. :eyes:
Mike (Eng): +1 on flags. Can we make the canary be per-tenant opt-in first (small cohort) rather than org-wide? less blast radius. also need a plan for KV-cache warmup during widen.
Sara (SRE): Agree with opt-in. Success metrics to check: p95 latency delta, error-rate (5xx), token throughput, and tail memory pressure. Canary pass if p95 <= baseline + 10ms AND 5xx delta < 0.1%. Otherwise auto-rollback.
Tim (Product): For A/B: want treatment to be 10% of traffic in EU after opt-in phase for 48h, then 30% for 24h, then widen. Also capture quality signals: hallucination rate on customer eval set (we'll surface from Redwood Optimize).
Julie (CS): For customer-driven asks: CS wants an opt-out toggle per-account and a rollout notification template. We should include a short rollback FAQ for top 10 customers.
Mike (Eng): Implementation notes: two things — routing and model variants. We should use smart routing policy to prefer regional pinned backends. Flag matrix: `ff.model_switch.mode = {off, opt-in, canary, widened}`; `ff.model_switch.variant = {quantized_v1, float32_v2}`. We'll stage variant config in Dedicated and Hosted.
Sara (SRE): Fallback policy sketch: primary -> if primary overloaded or latency SLO breached for X sec (configurable), route to fallback variant (lower-cost but stable) in same region. If that fails, region-level spill to nearest healthy region and signal degrade mode. Add circuit-breaker guard with exponential backoff.
Angela (PM): Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) Canary stability 48h (p95, errors), 2) Quality regressions < 1% on eval suite, 3) No persistent memory pressure alarms, 4) CS signoff for top 20 customers, 5) Runbook & rollback tested.
Tim (Product): Can we define canary alert thresholds now? Suggest: p95 increase > 10ms OR 5xx increase > 0.1% triggers immediate pause; persistent for 10 minutes triggers rollback. Also a manual kill switch in console.
Mike (Eng): Will add a canary script that samples traces and outputs a small summary to the rollout dashboard. Will post PR for flag schema + autoshed policy by EOD.
Sara (SRE): Add a shadow-run step prior to opt-in: mirror 10% of EU traffic to new variant with no return path and compare outputs against baseline. That should surface regressions without affecting customers.
Julie (CS): We'll prepare customer comms for opt-in cohort and update the support playbook with steps: detect, throttle, revert, escalate.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-deploy `model-switch-eu-canary` -> starts 2026-04-02T08:00Z. Trigger: manual.
Angela (PM): Next actions: Mike to PR flag schema + rollout script, Sara to add SRE checks & alert runbook, Julie to prep comms, Tim to finalise KPI gating. Sync in 24h to review PRs. :thumbsup:
